SCORE is Sri Chaitanya's national-level scholarship and talent search exam. It helps students earn scholarships (up to 100%) and secure admission into their classroom, academy centres, or online coaching programs.
Students studying in Grades 3 to 11 across India can appear for SCORE and showcase their academic potential.
When will the exam be conducted?

SCORE 2026 exams are scheduled across multiple dates: 11 October 2026 for Sri Chaitanya Coaching/Academy centres, and 4th October 2026 and 1st November 2026 for Sri Chaitanya Schools/Colleges. Your exact date and time slot will depend on your geographical location and chosen exam mode.
What are the benefits of writing SCORE?

SCORE helps students earn scholarships and prizes for their preparation of competitive exams such as NEET and IIT-JEE. It also helps students benchmark their academic preparation, compete with the best minds, and identify their learning gaps.
What scholarships can be won after writing SCORE?

Students can win scholarships of up to 100% on tuition fees for Sri Chaitanya's classroom, academy centres, or online coaching programs. Scholarship percentages vary based on performance and rank, helping deserving students access top-quality coaching at reduced or even free costs.
You can choose to take the exam offline at a nearby school, college, or academy center based on available exam slots. SCORE can also be taken online from home.
Yes, a nominal fee of ₹150 is charged to complete your registration.
What is the syllabus for SCORE?

It covers topics from the NCERT syllabus relevant to your previous grade along with the first two chapters of your current grade. The questions will test conceptual understanding and application skills.
How do I register for SCORE?
You can easily register online through Sri Chaitanya's official SCORE website.

What is Sri Chaitanya SCORE Scholarship Exam 2026?

The SCORE (Sri Chaitanya Outstanding Achievers Reward Examination) Is an All-India Scholarship and Talent Seach Exam. Sri Chaitanya Educational Institutions organizes this exam, to identify and reward talented students from Class 3 to Class 11 who aspire to excel in competitive exams like JEE, NEET, CBSE, ICSE, and State Board exams.

The primary objective of the SCORE Scholarship Exam 2026 is to offer financial support, upto 100% scholarships, and rewards including educational trips to NASA, exciting gadgets and cash prizes to the deserving students. It aims to motivate and prepare students for future academic challenges while making quality education accessible to all. This year SCORE is also offering 2.5 Crores worth cash rewards, 350 Cr worth scholarships.

How are Students Selected for the SCORE Exam?

Selection for the SCORE Scholarship Exam is based on a single written exam that includes two key sections: the Mental Ability Test (MAT) and the Scholastic Aptitude Test (SAT). The SCORE Exam pattern features objective-type questions answered on an OMR sheet, covering subjects like IQ, Math, Science, Physics, Chemistry, and Biology. This OMR-based exam ensures a fair and transparent scholarship selection process. Students with the highest scores in this All India Talent Search Exam are eligible for scholarships, cash rewards, gadgets, and NASA trips.
The SCORE Scholarship Exam is a decentralized program by Sri Chaitanya, meaning students from any part of India can participate. Based on SCORE Exam performance, students can win:
Exciting gadgets like tablets and smart devices
Special mentorship from expert Sri Chaitanya teachers
This scholarship ensures that talented students from all backgrounds have equal opportunities to excel.

Who Can Apply for the SCORE Exam?
Eligibility for the SCORE Scholarship Exam includes:
Students from Class 3 to Class 11 studying in CBSE, ICSE, or State Board schools
Anyone ready to take the MAT and SAT as part of the SCORE Talent Test
All students, regardless of family income—special focus on economically weaker sections
Scholarships for CBSE, ICSE, and State Board students are awarded purely on merit, ensuring a level playing field.
